نخروط (form XIII)
# نَخْرَوِّطُ (naḵrawwiṭu) /nax.raw.wi.tˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْرَوَّطَ (iḵrawwaṭa)
# نَخْرَوِّطَ (naḵrawwiṭa) /nax.raw.wi.tˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْرَوَّطَ (iḵrawwaṭa)
# نَخْرَوِّطْ (naḵrawwiṭ) /nax.raw.witˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْرَوَّطَ (iḵrawwaṭa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
